title: Defining Warehouses
titles: Defining a Warehouse's Rendered PDF File Directory
breadcrumbs: Defining a Warehouse's Rendered PDF File Directory

children:
In order to use the system, you must create a warehouse for all records 
 to be associated with.
Freight Bill To Address Tab Fields
Upload Receipt Details With 0 Quantity Received Checkbox
Upload Closed Receipts with 0 Quantity Received Checkbox
Split Consolidate Shipments on Upload Checkbox

Use the Warehouse Address 
 Tab fields to define the warehouse's general shipping 
 information.

- Use the UCC/EAN 
 Number Field  to provide 
 the UCC/EAN 
 identifier assigned to this warehouse. This number is a warehouse prefix 
 that is a unique value which identifies this warehouse. Note that if you 
 define company(s) 
 in the Company Window, then you do not need to provide this value. You 
 will have to provide a UCC/EAN 
 Number for each company in the Company Window.

Use the Returns 
 Address Tab fields to identify where all product shipped for this 
 warehouse will be returned.

Use the Freight 
 Bill To Address Tab fields to identify the billing address, if 
 it is different than the shipping address.

Use the Authorized 
 Users Tab Checkboxes to assign employees to this warehouse. Only employees that you 
 select from this tab will be able to process entities in this warehouse.
Use the Interface tab fields to identify if data should be interfaced for certain process conditions based on the company.
Use the Miscellaneous Tab fields to define several warehouse-related values:

- Use the Rendered Document PDF File Directory Field in the warehouse as well as in the document type to indicate where you want SQL Server Reporting Services to place rendered (created).pdf files. Note that these .pdf files are not automatically deleted from this directory after they are printed by the default PDF reader application. For additional information, refer to the
Rendered Document PDF File Directory Field

Press OK. 
 The system will save your record.
